name: habit-tracker
description: A personal habit-tracking app with streaks, statistics, and a clean dashboard.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @habit/api" "npm run dev -w @habit/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @habit/shared && npm run build -w @habit/api && npm run build -w @habit/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @habit/api && npm run lint -w @habit/web
